matches.quote: Normalising by F_z, the quantity being varied, hides the true F_z dependence at fixed F_ac... give Ω in MHz for a stated, realistic drive... at B0 = 0.05 T
Relaxed Ge1−xSn_x buffers typically carry Sn compositional fluctuations, Sn segregation... modulate ε∥ and the confinement locally, and so shift the LH–HH splitting and F_z*
The model (Figs. 1–3) assumes a fully strained, defect-free Ge layer, 15 nm thick... coherent on relaxed Ge0.84Sn0.16... high-Sn relaxed GeSn buffers suffer from Sn segregation and precipitation.

The claims about hybrid superconducting devices are unsupported. The abstract and conclusion state that the large in-plane g-factor (g∥^c ≈ −8, Fig. 2e) 'facilitates the integration of superconductors'
Because g⊥ (Fig. 2a, 2c, Fig. 3) and β1 vary strongly with F_z, the qubit frequency will be sensitive to electric-field noise... give ∂ω/∂F_z... along the β-line
The 6-band k·p model leaves out the conduction band, which matters most in this strain regime.
The perturbative effective Hamiltonians are used where their control parameters are not small... HH–LH and HH–HH quasi-degeneracies shrink the energy denominators
The zero of β1 exists because of the asymmetry between the top surface barrier and the triangular Ge/GeSn barrier... It appears to be modelled as a hard wall
interface traps, roughness and fixed charge typical of Ge MOS interfaces, which screen F_z and add disorder... in the regime of strong leakage and charge trapping
Give the actual confinement energies ħω_x, ħω_y and the orbital splittings... so readers can judge whether l_x = 35 nm and l_y = 60 nm are realistic
Panel (b) uses x = 10%, while (c) and the rest of the paper use x = 16%; it is unclear whether x = 10% gives a LH ground state
interface-induced HH–LH mixing (C2v symmetry)... add a field-independent linear-in-k term that would generally stop β1 from vanishing... inhomogeneous strain from the gate electrodes
propose a gating geometry that tunes F_z across F_z* at fixed few-hole occupancy.
give Ω in MHz for a stated, realistic drive... compare directly, in the same units, with a conventional strained Ge/SiGe HH dot... and with Ge/Si nanowire direct Rashba SOI.
Without this, the claimed qubit advantages, the robustness and the comparison with the cited 'spinless' qubit proposal [63] are not supported.
The advance over the authors' earlier work is not stated. Refs. 56 and 57 already established the large linear Rashba term in LH Ge/GeSn wells
